workflow: An operation caches raw pointers into mutable internal state before invoking user-controlled callback logic.
The callback re-enters the owning object and replaces or releases that internal state.
The outer operation continues using the cached pointers without revalidating or retaining their backing storage.
A later access dereferences the stale pointers, causing use-after-free instead of completing safely.
summary: Reentrant mutation invalidates cached internal state
decision_reason: The underlying workflow materially matches reentrant callback code detaching or releasing a backing resource before the outer operation uses it again; the specific object, callback, and state types are implementation details.
